worldcombat.skill.psystrike.summary: Pile the psychic wave into one heavy mass above the target and let it crash down: the slam settles special damage against physical Defence, spreads a shock front outward in wide mode, and cracks the target's mental guard for a 1-stage Sp. Def drop.
worldcombat.skill.psystrike.use.0: Bring a physical-Defence psychic slam onto one heavy target
worldcombat.skill.psystrike.use.1: Crack Sp. Def to open up follow-up special attacks
worldcombat.skill.psystrike.use.2: Press a field in a crowd and catch the neighbours
Within %1$s blocks, the mass forms %3$s blocks above the target and crashes down, settling %2$s special damage against its physical Defence.
Track the target while descending at %1$s blocks per tick. Hit radius: %2$s blocks.
The slam cracks the mental guard, lowering the target's Sp. Def by %1$s stage(s).
Once the mass lands, the shock front reaches %2$s blocks, dealing another %1$s special damage to other non-allies inside and shoving them about 0.6 blocks away.
worldcombat.skill.psystrike.wide.on: Wide press: the landing spreads a shock front that deals partial damage and knockback to other non-allies inside, at the cost of x0.85 main power, +3 ticks wind-up and +8 ticks cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.psystrike.wide.off: Point press: only the target is pressed, with x1.12 main power and a faster cast.
worldcombat.skill.psystrike.timing: Range %1$s blocks, wind-up %2$s, recovery %3$s, %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.psystrike.growth.0: From level %1$s the press rises to %2$s power and %3$s blocks of range.
worldcombat.skill.psystrike.growth.1: From level %1$s the press rises to %2$s power and the shock front to %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.psystrike.preference.w: On: the landing spreads a shock front about 2-5 blocks wide, dealing partial damage and knockback to other non-allies inside, at the cost of x0.85 main power, +3 ticks wind-up and +8 ticks cooldown. Off (point press): only the target is pressed, with x1.12 main power and a faster cast.
worldcombat.skill.psystrike.preference.a: Beyond this distance the companion closes in before piling the mass; larger values let it open from further away.
On: targets attacking the companion or its owner rank higher, crushing the most dangerous one. Off: ordinary ranged ordering.
